title: A 10-point projected headroom erosion clears the T4 pressure threshold
note: erosion = current_headroom - projected_headroom = 25.00 - 15.00 = 10.00 points. T4's threshold_pct = headroom_erosion_pct(0.05) * 100 = 5.00 points. 10.00 >= 5.00, so this covenant's erosion counts toward forecast pressure and it is the (only, hence maximum) driving covenant.
